questions.question: What is the primary role of a Hardware Description Language (HDL) like Verilog or VHDL in digital IC design?
options: To describe the behavior and structure of digital circuits at an abstract level.
To program the firmware that runs on the embedded processor within the IC.
To perform post-silicon validation and debugging.
To manage the physical layout and routing of interconnects on the chip.
To simulate the analog characteristics of mixed-signal components.

questions.question: In the physical design flow of an Application-Specific Integrated Circuit (ASIC), what is the primary purpose of a 'Floorplan'?
options: To verify that the manufactured chip matches the design netlist.
To identify and fix timing violations in critical paths.
To define the overall chip area, placement of large blocks (macros), I/O pins, and initial power/ground distribution.
To convert the gate-level netlist into a set of manufacturing masks.
To automatically route all the signal connections between standard cells.

questions.question: Which type of cache replacement policy aims to evict the cache line that will not be used for the longest period of time in the future, although it is practically impossible to implement perfectly and serves as an optimal theoretical benchmark?
options: Least Recently Used (LRU)
First-In, First-Out (FIFO)
Least Frequently Used (LFU)
Random
Optimal (OPT or MIN)

questions.question: What is the main reason for performing 'Design Rule Check' (DRC) during the physical verification stage of an Integrated Circuit?
options: To ensure that the circuit meets its specified timing requirements.
To verify that the circuit's functional behavior matches its RTL description.
To ensure that the layout adheres to the foundry's manufacturing process rules for reliable fabrication.
To confirm the equivalence between the gate-level netlist and the schematic diagram.
To identify and correct electrical connectivity issues such as floating nodes or power shorts.

questions.question: Which architectural approach primarily aims to maximize the number of instructions executed per clock cycle by fetching and executing multiple independent instructions simultaneously using multiple execution units?
options: Reduced Instruction Set Computer (RISC)
Very Long Instruction Word (VLIW)
Complex Instruction Set Computer (CISC)
Superscalar
Single Instruction, Multiple Data (SIMD)
